proposed_reviewed.reason: Statement and steps 1.2, 1.3, 4.1: the test uses S4 and its periodic product, not an arbitrary empty background. The index-one hypothesis forces n_++n_- odd and hence nonzero, so an empty zero-mode sector is excluded on this test. The finite normalization groupoid BC2 has one object and two automorphisms; its normalized combined sum is 1/2, not an empty sum. These checks assert nothing for other background families.

Definition, final specified-vertex paragraph: n>=1, so the momentum-conservation sum has n terms and the maximum defining E is over the nonempty finite set of four components per external leg. An empty-leg vertex and its undefined maximum are outside that low-energy clause. The selected massive sector has the stated two Weyl fields and M_H>0; zero compactly supported B or theta is allowed and is not an empty fermion spectrum.
